content:
Hi everyone!

TypeSig is the University of Edinburgh undergraduate society for theoretical CS, and we run an annual problem series called Advent of Proof, similar to Advent of Code, where short, daily problems in maths, logic, proof theory etc. are given as statements to prove in a theorem prover (Lean and Agda have historically been supported).

We're looking for new challenges for this year's edition. Ideally, this comes as a Lean or Agda file (so no Mathlib) setting up the statement, and with a description explaining the problem. However, we are also open to ideas too! Examples of previous challenges can be found at https://homepages.inf.ed.ac.uk/loconno/ (requires a Discord login).

Thanks! :)
Cool initiative, I didn't know about it, thanks for sharing! One question: when I go to that link and log in, I only see the 2023 challenges. Where can I find the 2024 and 2025 challenges?
